update.name: SettingsModal — THEME + AUDIO + SANDBOX + ACCOUNT + ADS
update.context: SettingsModal is triggered by the gear icon (U+2699, not emoji, not image) in the TopBar. It has 5 tabs: THEME | AUDIO | SANDBOX | ACCOUNT | ADS. ADS tab is new — manages rewarded ad preferences and shows current FD (Farkle Dust) balance earned via rewarded ads. ThemeToggle has been moved from inline UI into THEME tab. This is part of the screen-fit layout — modal overlays the game, does not push content or scroll.

dependencies.dep: update-38 — analytics context available but not blocking

constraints.constraint: Gear trigger is U+2699 text character — not an emoji, not a Lucide icon.
ACCOUNT tab is LEFT of the X button in tab row.
SandboxTab imported lazily — do not eager-import heavy components.
No framer-motion — use motion/react for modal open/close animation.
Modal does not scroll the page — it is self-contained with internal scroll if needed.
No non-ASCII characters in source file.

do-not.rule: Do not inline ThemeToggle as a separate component — absorb its logic into THEME tab.
Do not use emoji for the gear trigger — U+2699 text only.
Do not make the ADS tab visible when adsEnabled config flag is false.
Do not push page content when modal opens — overlay only.

verification.check: Gear icon renders as U+2699 text character
ACCOUNT tab is positioned left of X close button
ADS tab hidden when adsEnabled is false
Modal closes on backdrop click and X button
